content.description: Illustration showing crankshaft pulley with timing mark aligned to TDC mark

items: (a) Turn the crankshaft pulley until the timing mark is aligned with the TDC mark.

content.description: Illustration showing journal match hole on camshaft housing aligned with camshaft match hole

items: (c) Make sure that the match hole on the No. 2 journal of the camshaft housing is aligned with that of the camshaft.

content.text: NOTE: If not, turn the crankshaft one full turn.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of O-ring to distributor

items: (d) Install the new O-ring to the distributor.

content.text: NOTE: Always use a new O-ring when installing the distributor.

content.description: Illustration showing alignment of distributor matchmarks with spiral gear and housing

items: (e) Align the matchmark of the distributor (the drillmark on spiral gear) with that of distributor housing.
(f) Insert the distributor, aligning the center of flange with that of the bolt hole on cylinder head.

content.description: Illustration showing pickup coil and signal rotor in distributor

items: (g) Align the rotor tooth with the pickup coil.
(h) Temporarily install the distributor set bolt.
(i) Install the distributor cap with wires.
